s: Dine netilat yadayim ubo k"a seipim: kol adam haqqam mimmittato shacharit, ben asa tzerakayv ben lo asa tzerakayv — tzarik lirchotz yadayv birbiit hallog mayim min hakkeli, vaapillu eno rotzeh lehitpallel ad leachar kamma shaot, lepi shekkol adam keshehaqqadosh-baruk-hu machazir lo nishmato — naaseh kibriyya chadasha, kemo shekkatub: "chadashim labbeqarim ku'", shehaadam mapqid nishmato ayepa, vehaqqadosh-baruk-hu machazir lo chadasha uregua, kede laabod lehashshem yitbarek bekol yekolto, uleshorto kol hayyom, ki zeh kol haadam. Lepikak, tzerikim anachnu lehitqaddesh biqdushshato, velittol yadenu min hakkeli, kede laabod abodato uleshorto, kemo kohen shehaya meqaddesh yadayv min hakkiyyor bekol yom qodem abodato. Vekevan shetztzarik littol yadayv min hakkeli davqa, laken yebarek "al netilat yadayim", velo "al rechitzat yadayim", mippene shehakkeli shemmimmennu notelin layyadayim — niqra "natla" belashon chaza"l, laken tiqqenu bibraka zo leshon netila, lehorot detzarik keli:
Bintila zo en tzarik sheyyabou hammayim al yadayv mikkoach adam davqa, ella apillu shipshep yadayv betok keli shel mayim — olta lo netila:

Im en lo keli kelal, ella rochetz yadayv bemayim sheubim shello min hakkeli, o sheen lo mayim kede shiur rebiit hallog — lo yimmana bishbil zeh millebarek "al netilat yadayim", mishshum delo pelug rabbanan, kevan sherochetz yadayv bemayim hakkesherim lintila. Abal im en lo kelal mayim hakkesherim lintila, al derek sheyyitbaer leqamman besiman qas, im eno rotzeh lehitpallel ad leachar zeman merubbeh, beopen sheyyassiach dato mishshemirat yadayv veyitztarek littol yadayv paam acheret kede lehitpallel — azay lo yebarek kelal al netila zo. Veim en lo mayim kelal, im rotzeh lehitpallel miyyad — tzarik lenaqqot yadayv qodem hattepilla bitzror o beapar o beqora o bekol mide dimnaqqe, vibarek "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu al neqiyyut yadayim". Veim eno rotzeh lehitpallel miyyad — en tzarik apillu lenaqqot et yadayv, im shakab bemalbushayv, veyakol lebarek ken beli netilat yadayim kol birkot hashshachar, distam yadayim sheeno yodea lahem shum tuma — enan pesulot libraka, shello tiqqenu rechitzat yadayim ella liqriat shema utepilla bilbad. Abal im haya yashen al mittato arom — asur lehazkir [shum] shem mishshiba shemot sheenan nimchaqin, o lehotzi dibre tora mippiv, ad sheyyenaqqeh et yadayv bekol mide dimnaqqe, mishshum demissetama naga bammeqomot hamkussim shebbaadam, kegon: shoq veyarek vekayyotze bahem sheyyesh bahem milmule zea, shehayyadayim asqaniyyot hen:

Ameru chakamim: kol hayyashen ballayla shishshim neshimot [kevan] shennistalleqa mimmennu nishmato — baa ruach hattuma veshora al gupo, umiyyad shenneor mishshenato — nistalleqa ruach hattuma min kol gupo chutz min yadayv, sheen ruach hattuma mistalleq mealehem ad sheyyishpok mayim al yadayv shalosh peamim, al kol yad bipne atzmo. Velo yishpok al yad achat shalosh peamim retzupim, ella paam achat al yamin upaam achat al semol, veken yaaseh shalosh peamim:

Veqodem sheyyittelem al derek shennitbaer — lo yigga beyadayv lappeh shello yitallem, velo laoznayim shello yitcharesh, velo laenayim shello yistamme, velo lachotem velo lappeh shello yehe baal polippus, dehaynu reach hachotem vehappeh:
Veken lo yigga beyadayv qodem netila bimqom haqqaza. Veken lo yigga leshum maakal o mashqeh, shello yetammeem:

En tzarik lenaggeb hayyadayim achar hannetila shel shacharit. Umuttar lebarek birkat "al netilat yadayim" beli niggub. Vehu haddin shear kol habberakot. Veen tzarik littol ella haetzbaot. Umihu tob sheyyittelem ad pereq hazzeroa:
Netilat yadayim shacharit — en notelin al gabbe qarqa, ella letok keli. Vetob sheyyehe keli hattachton maus:

Mayim shel netilat yadayim shacharit — asur lehishtammesh bahem shum tashmish, mippene sheasur lehanot mehem, mippene ruach raa sheshshora alehen. Velaken lo yelinem babbayit. Veken yizzaher shello yishpekem babbayit, velo beshum maqom sheoberim sham bene adam, shemma yigga bahem adam veyuzzaq:

Keshehu notel yadayv — tzarik littol yad yemino techilla, mittaam shennitbaer besiman b. Ulepi shettob hu shemmin yad yamin yabou hammayim al yadayv letaharam, mittaam shennitbaer bazzohar, lepikak yittol keli shel mayim beyad yemino venoteno lismolo, kede sheyyishpok mayim al yemino techilla:
Velo yishpok lo al yadayv mi sheadayin lo natal yadayv shacharit, shenneemar: "vehizza hattahor al hattame":

Im shikshek yadayv letok keli shel mayim shalosh peamim bikli echad — lo olta lo netila lehaabir ruach raa mealehen, shemmiyyad sheshshikshek yadayv paam rishona betok hakkeli — nitmeu kol hammayim shebbakkeli, vehavyan keme shopekin. Veim shikshek yadayv shalosh peamim bishlosha memot mechullapim, o bannahar deqammai qammai azle lehu vehanne acharine ninehu — yesh lehistappeq im olta lo netila lehaabir ruach raa shealehen. Vetob sheyyachazor veyittelem kedinam, mippene sheepshar sheen ruach raa mistalleqet mehayyadayim ella al yede eruy shalosh peamim mehakkeli:

Im haya neor kol hallayla — tzarik littol yadayv miyyad kesheyyeor hayyom, ap-al-pi shebbekol hallayla lo hissiach dato mishshemirat yadayv, kegon shehinnichan bebatte yadayim — ap-al-pi-ken tzarik littol yadayv min hakkeli belo beraka kesheyyeor hayyom, mippene sheepshar dikshettiqqenu chakamim netilat yadayim bekol shachar mittaam shennitbaer besaip a — lo ratzu lechalleq ben yashan denaasa beriyya chadasha, lelo yashan kelal:

Hammashkim qodem ammud hashshachar venatal yadayv — tob sheyyachazor viareh al yadayv shalosh peamim kedinam kesheyyeor hayyom, mippene sheepshar shellayla hi goremet sheyyishreh ruach raa al hayyadayim apillu belo shena. Umikkol maqom apillu hishkib atzmo achar-kak lishon paam sheniyya shenat qeba, devadday shora ruach raa al yadayv vetzarik learot alehen shalosh peamim kesheyyaqum mimmittato — ap-al-pi-ken lo yebarek al netila zo, delo tiqqenu birkat "al netilat yadayim" ella keshennaaseh beriyya chadasha kemo shennitbaer besaip a, ubeshena zo hashshenit lo naasa beriyya chadasha, depaam achat naaseh beriyya chadasha velo shette peamim:
Im yashan bayyom shiur shishshim neshimot — tob sheyyeareh al yadayv mayim shalosh peamim, mippene sheepshar shehashshena [hi] goremet shettishreh ruach raa al hayyadayim apillu bayyom:

David hammelek alayv hashshalom haya nizhar shello lishon kol hallayla shishshim neshimot retzupin, kede shello yitom taam mita, raq haya mitnamnem kesus ad chatzot layla, ubachatzot layla haya mitgabber kaari:
Yesh nohagin lirchotz pihem shacharit, mippene haririm shebbetok happeh, kede lebarek et shem haggadol biqdushsha ubetohora:

Ellu debarim shehen tzerikin netila bemayim davqa, velo bekol mide dimnaqqe, abal en tzarik learot al yadayv shalosh peamim, ellu hen: haqqam mehammitta, vehayyotze mibbet hakkisse umibbet hammerchatz, vehannotel tzippornayv, vehacholetz minalayv beyadayv, vehannogea beraglayv, vehannogea begupo beyado, vehachopep rosho, vehannogea bekinna, vehamshammesh mittato, umi shemmepalleh kelayv apillu lo naga bekinna shello matza, vehaholek ben haqqebarot, umi shennaga bemet. Abal im halak etzel met — en tzarik netila, umihu nahagu littol apillu niknas lemet echad, vehu haddin hamlavvin oto. Umi sheasa achat mikkol ellu velo natal yadayv, im talmid chakam hu — talmudo mishtakkeach, veim eno talmid chakam — yotze middato:

Hammaqqiz dam mehakketepayim velo natal yadayv achar-kak — mepached shiba yamim veeno yodea mimmah mepached. Hamgalleach searo velo natal yadayv — mepached shelosha yamim. Hannotel tzippornayv velo natal yadayv — mepached yom echad:
Harochetz panayv velo niggebam yapeh — panayv mitbaqqeot, o oleh bahem shechin, urepuato lirchotz harbeh beme teradin:
Rochetz adam panayv veraglayv bekol yom — bishbil kebod qono, shenneemar: "ki betzelem elohim asa et haadam":
